support_definition.IN_SUPPORT: maxabsz<=3 AND leverage_ratio<=1 AND no constant departure
support_definition.EXTRAPOLATION_CAUTION: maxabsz<=5 AND leverage_ratio<=2 AND no constant departure
support_definition.HIGH_EXTRAPOLATION: otherwise; research inference only, not default application eligible
support_definition.leverage: z'(Z'Z+alphaI)^-1 z divided by train 99th percentile; train Z only

zero_std: unchanged P2 flags ->zero anomaly; unseen departure high risk
